scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

accepted_operation.additional_names: Only three-digit-prefix -start.json, -start.stdout and -start.stderr entries in that exact directory.
accepted_operation.output: Captured stdout JSON with raw base64 and exact integer metadata; missing selected files reported explicitly.

conditions: Use the exact recorded argv with inherited askpass and the existing owned capture enforcing the15-second wall bound; the argv itself contains no wall-time limiter.
Keep other work held. Stop on the first unexpected file type, identity change, size/count bound or command failure; preserve the resulting capture.
Preserve every owner, lease, lock and failed-operation record. This operation grants no cleanup, signal, unlock, Docker query, census, guest or replay authority.
